arChildNodes.szComment: TYRAEL slows to a halt - something's caught his eye. LORATH'S STAFF. He kneels to pick it up.
A MURDER OF CROWS soars overhead.

Player runs, LEAPS across a gap. The ground gives way where we jumped from. Tyrael JUMPS BACK from the ledge. 

Tyrael is safe, but there's no getting across.

PLAYER RUNS ahead.

Player slows: we see ADREONA in the distance.She's silhouetted against a dying campfire, arms are wrapped around Lorath in a lovers' embrace. 

A crow CAWS. Something's not right.
CLOSE UP on Adreona. She looks bone-tired, emotionally exhausted. Lorath's head is nestled against her chin.

Adreona turns. She's holding LORATH'S SEVERED HEAD. A DEAFENING CHORUS OF CROWS drowns out the world. 

Player stares, anguished. CAWS.

Adreona's sword is bloody. CAWS. 

Adreona lets Lorath’s head fall to the ground. CAWS.
